caption: PPRD East TTX — one phone plays every role: Director, Mayor, Fire Commander, Regional Civil Protection.
Each player picks a language. Regional Civil Protection will play in Armenian.
The Director starts the exercise. Day 1, 13:00: a wildfire is burning on Pine Hill.
The Director sends the first injects from the MSEL. The AI translates each one for its recipient.
The Mayor receives the injects in Italian: the fire, and 120 pupils at Pineta Primary School.
The Mayor answers in Italian, in their own words.
The Fire Commander orders fire lines using zone codes from the map grid, plus an air-tanker drop.
The AI turns each reply into commands. The simulator checks each one against the role’s authority and resources…
…and flags a real constraint: evacuating 120 pupils needs 3 buses, but the Mayor has only 2.
The Director writes an AI prompt: one extra bus for the Mayor, confirmed by an inject.
The Director reviews the AI’s proposal (a resource change plus an inject draft) and approves it.
Now the Fire Commander’s orders are approved, with a note to the player…
…and the Mayor’s orders pass this time: 3 buses for 120 pupils.
The Mayor gets exercise control’s feedback in Italian.
The Director resolves turn 1: 30 simulated minutes, simulated live on the big screen at 120×.
Flame length follows fireline intensity and the share of Monte Carlo runs that burn each cell; the glow ahead is where only some runs reach.
Fire lines cut, the drop made, the school evacuated to the sports centre.
Every player gets an AI-written situation update for their role.
Turn 2. The Director escalates: a wind warning, then commands by code (wind 55 km/h, a new fire in zone G5).
Regional Civil Protection reads the wind warning in Armenian and asks for international assistance (UCPM).
A vague order from the Fire Commander…
…gets a clarification question from the AI instead of a guess.
The Fire Commander answers precisely.
The Director rejects the vague order and approves the UCPM request and the precise fire lines.
Resolve turn 2: 60 minutes, live. Reinforcements arrive; the lines protect Pineta; the new fire in G5 spreads through the farmland.
Every inject, reply, AI interpretation, decision and consequence is logged for the debrief. Humans decide, the AI mediates.
